title: last step is send not volgende
rule: Last step is not “Volgende” — final submit names send (`Versturen` / outcome). Show a check-page of answers with edit before that. Dual-cite GOV.UK check-answers; this names the label change on the last step.
pass_when: Last-step button names send/outcome, not “Volgende”; answers are shown with edit before send.
fail_when: Last step still says “Volgende” / “Next”, or there is no check-page with edit.
not_when: Not for single form on one screen.
agent_hint: Last step is not “Volgende” — final submit names send (`Versturen` / outcome).
description: Last step is not “Volgende” — final submit names send (`Versturen` / outcome). Last-step button names send/outcome, not “Volgende”. It fails when Last step still says “Volgende” / “Next”, or there is no check-page with edit.
do_not_claim: GOV.UK check-answers as a merge that drops the last-step label change; GOLD Next-primary/Save-secondary; “Volgende stap”/“Vorige stap” as a second Actions clone (kept in this row).
